text_block_list.text:
Apparently there's an event at the dance school
I visited with Narita Top Road before.
We decided to head over after taking care of some errands.
choice_data_list: I heard it's a dance party, but are you going to be okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! I've undergone special training so I can dance without bumping into anyone around me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I was thinking that the trick for moving through crowds you taught me before might also apply to dancing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've been practicing dancing while keeping a wide field of view!
I hope I can show the results of that today!

On the decorated dance floor, attendees were dancing freely to the music.
Among them, Narita Top Road was—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Cast your gaze far ahead.
Be conscious of catching things in the corner of your eye—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I broke free...!
Now I can run however I please—
choice_data_list: (Wow, this is totally different from last time...!)

text_block_list.text:
Having overcome her weakness, her dance was
brilliant and utterly captivating.

Haha! You really know how to put on a show,
Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Tap-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Your dance just now was bursting with energy!
Your expression's brightened up a whole lot, too!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, a fire's been lit in my heart.
Care to dance with me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Yes, gladly!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha!!
Now that's a beat that gets the heart pounding!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Not yet!!
This isn't all I'm capable of!!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Those two are amazing...!
Both of them are seriously sparkling!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance born from competing with each other—
truly a synergy of passion...!

Before anyone knew it, everyone on the floor stopped dancing
and watched the two of them perform.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. After all that dancing,
I've worked up quite a sweat.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Your dance was amazing!
I was so captivated that I completely lost track of time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Fufu, hearing you say that makes me so happy, Tap-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If you wouldn't mind,
would you care to dance with me again?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I promise!
I'm fine with doing it tomorrow, too."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Phew.
I was able to dance to my heart's content!
choice_data_list: Your flair really made it shine!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Fufu, Tap-chan told me the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I could really feel it myself.
I danced exactly the way I had pictured in my heart!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
We should be grateful to Trainer
for helping us find the key to solving this problem!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to your hard work!
It's all thanks to your hard work!
You were undoubtedly the star of the day.
You were undoubtedly the star of the day.
Will you dance with me next time?
Would you care to dance with me next?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
We should be grateful to Trainer
for helping us find the key to solving this problem!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to your hard work!
It's all thanks to your hard work!
You were undoubtedly the star of the day.
You were undoubtedly the star of the day.
Will you dance with me next time?
Would you care to dance with me next?

text_block_list.text:
I only provided the catalyst.
Turning that into overcoming her weakness
was the fruit of Narita Top Road's own hard work.
choice_data_list: So I want you to be more proud of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes!
I'm going to grow so much more from now on!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So Trainer, please keep the advice coming!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Hearing you say that makes me blush!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I... want to take center stage in races,
just like in today's dance!
choice_data_list: As your Trainer, I'll support you with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I look forward to continuing to work with you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. You're quite playful, aren't you, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I gladly accept your invitation.
Shall we go dance in the park over there?

Afterward, with her taking the lead,
we danced the night away to our hearts' content.
